activeQuestion.prompt: What must be done before locations are selected?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 選定地點前必須做什麼？

options.text: Discuss operating details with center managers
options.zh: 和中心經理討論營運細節
options.whyZh: 研究人員必須先和社區中心的管理者談開放時間和無障礙條件，再選地點。

options.text: Publish a new internet price list
options.whyZh: 調查顯示重點不是網速，也未提價格。

options.text: Build a permanent office in each neighborhood
options.zh: 每個社區興建永久辦公室
options.whyZh: 方案避免新建，只先試兩區。

options.text: Ask all participants to buy desks
options.zh: 要求所有參與者買桌子
options.whyZh: 參與者線上預約桌位，不是買桌。

group.title: A research presentation
group.passage: M1: Our survey of remote workers produced a result we hadn't expected. We assumed that most respondents would want faster internet service. Instead, the most common request was access to a quiet workspace near home. Many people said that family activity made it difficult to concentrate, even when their internet connection was reliable. Based on this finding, we recommend testing a shared workspace program in two residential neighborhoods. The trial would use meeting rooms in existing community centers, so no new buildings would be required. Participants would reserve desks through a simple online calendar. Before choosing the locations, however, we need to interview the center managers about opening hours and accessibility. The full survey results are available in the report circulated this morning.
group.passageZh: 遠距工作者調查出現意料之外的結果。我們本以為多數人想要更快網路，最常見需求卻是住家附近安靜的工作場所。許多人說即使網路可靠，家中其他人的活動也讓他們難以專心。根據結果，建議在兩個住宅區試辦共用工作空間，使用既有社區中心會議室，不必新建大樓。參與者透過簡易線上日曆預約桌位。但選地點前，需要訪問中心經理，了解開放時間及無障礙條件。完整調查結果在今早發送的報告中。
